sloka: प्रियम् जनम् अपश्यन्तीम् पश्यन्तीम् राक्षसी गणम् ।स्व गणेन मृगीम् हीनाम् श्व गण अभिवृताम् इव ॥५-१५-२४॥
transliteration: priyam janam apaśyantīm paśyantīm rākṣasī gaṇam ।sva gaṇena mṛgīm hīnām śva gaṇa abhivṛtām iva ॥5-15-24॥

translations.english: Unable to see her dear kith and kin, she sat guarded by ogresses. She appeared like a doe separated from the herd and encircled by a pack of hounds.
